err.message:
🔁 parent: local restack on newer main; branch commits match remote. Publication is pending.
Local and remote histories differ for child, although their tracked parent is the same.
This may include an unpublished local restack; different commit IDs alone do not establish incoming changes.
You can either overwrite your copy of the branch, or rebase your local changes onto the remote version.
You can also abort the command entirely and keep your local state as is.
ERROR: Local and remote histories differ for child. Retry sync interactively to choose a resolution. Sync --force only authorizes cleanup and trunk reset; it does not authorize feature overwrite.
